note: CANDIDATE OFFICIAL (the user, 2 Nov): the staging pool - aeroplanes designed and built, not validated. The garage offers them under 'candidate official' (the load rack and the new-aeroplane cards), in the sandbox and a career, from these files (not the browser's storage). No certificate, not in the career catalogue, the contracts or the story. The file names are the user's / the builders' own and stay as they are. Add one: node tools/candidates_add.js <a build or an 'export all' file>.
